title: fix(update): settle Doctor writers before recovering migrated Gateways

commit.messageHeadline: fix(update): settle Doctor process groups before Gateway recovery
refactor(update): keep settlement diagnostics within existing owners
fix(update): retain Doctor writer custody across parent death
fix(update): preserve normal Windows Doctor completion
fix(doctor): scope update custody to supported invocations
fix(doctor): defer native custody until child admission
fix(update): preserve Doctor refusals when reporting fails
fix(update): retain original refusals alongside reporting causes
test(update): assert preserved Doctor exit in failure report
fix(process): supply custody admission fallback message
test(update): reuse compiled runtime in database rollback fixtures
test(gateway): compare normalized quiescence diagnostics
fix(update): settle Doctor writers after command rejection
fix(update): preserve refusals before Doctor receives its grant
fix(update): retire Doctor custody before recovering migrated Gateways
fix(update): restore retired lease decoder import
fix(update): retire failed Doctor launches before settlement
refactor(update): reuse canonical lease reader for cancellation
test(gateway): await database retirement before corrupting fixtures
test(gateway): align startup fixture repair with main
fix(update): integrate async progress ownership with Doctor settlement
refactor(update): simplify Doctor custody owners
test(update): repair Doctor custody proof fixtures
fix(update): drain state writers before recovery snapshots

Codex review: needs real behavior proof before merge. _Reviewed October 2, 2026, 3:31 AM ET / 07:31 UTC (Revision 21)._ # ClawSweeper review ## What this changes The updater retains Doctor child-process custody, retires settled writer claims before recovering migrated Gateways, and drains local database writers before taking recovery snapshots. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Blocked before merge - 4 items remain** This PR remains necessary: current main covers the snapshot correction but not the central Doctor settlement recovery path. No concrete blocking patch defect was found; the prior final-effect authority proof gap remains unresolved. **Priority:** P0 **Reviewed head:** `2b7e5700f6adada2a0fe8a7a10a6b2092a9fde05` ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | The patch has substantial useful coverage and retained real recovery evidence, but the current authority boundary is not yet proven through native activation. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | Needs stronger real behavior proof before merge: Authority-chain proof required: the retained packaged trace proves settlement and healthy recovery at faaabc09b9338ef3e2c985fa696d0bb5ac0d8bba before async-progress integration; current recovery coverage mocks restart and health. Show allowed recovery and rejection before native activation for a revoked requester and replaced parent generation. Existing stored-payload compatibility is supported independently by optional decoding, reclamation coverage, and the published-driver cell. After adding proof, update the PR body; ClawSweeper should re-review automatically. If it does not, the PR author or someone with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review`. | | **Patch quality** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | Security review found an item that needs attention. | ## Verification | Check | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---| | **Real behavior** | Needs proof | Needs stronger real behavior proof before merge: Authority-chain proof required: the retained packaged trace proves settlement and healthy recovery at faaabc09b9338ef3e2c985fa696d0bb5ac0d8bba before async-progress integration; current recovery coverage mocks restart and health. Show allowed recovery and rejection before native activation for a revoked requester and replaced parent generation. Existing stored-payload compatibility is supported independently by optional decoding, reclamation coverage, and the published-driver cell. After adding proof, update the PR body; ClawSweeper should re-review automatically. If it does not, the PR author or someone with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review`. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 10 items | Pinned introduction and clean checkout: Reviewed the introduced merge-base-to-head delta. The checkout remains clean; the supplied stale test merge was not used to infer removal of current-main behavior.
Central work remains absent from main: Current main still requires a failed database rollback receipt for migrated recovery and lacks the new Doctor process-custody owner. That owner is also absent from the supplied latest-release commit.
Settlement precedes retirement: The parent captures exact native claims, awaits tracked-group settlement, and retires claims only when settlement succeeds and no unidentified reservation remains. | | **Findings** | None | None. | | **Security** | Needs attention | Verify stale authority cannot activate the Gateway: The changed custody and recovery path crosses process lifetimes and asynchronous publication. Available current coverage does not show requester revocation or parent-generation replacement being rejected before native activation. | ## How this fits together OpenClaw's updater runs Doctor against the candidate installation before completing Gateway activation. Process settlement and current update authority determine whether recovery may restart the Gateway on preserved migrated state. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Candidate update] --> B[Doctor and child commands] B --> C[Durable process custody] C --> D[Prove process extinction] D --> E[Revalidate update authority] E --> F[Restart and verify Gateway] D --> G[Keep Gateway stopped] E --> G ``` ## Before merge - [ ] **Add real behavior proof** - Needs stronger real behavior proof before merge: Authority-chain proof required: the retained packaged trace proves settlement and healthy recovery at faaabc09b9338ef3e2c985fa696d0bb5ac0d8bba before async-progress integration; current recovery coverage mocks restart and health. Show allowed recovery and rejection before native activation for a revoked requester and replaced parent generation. Existing stored-payload compatibility is supported independently by optional decoding, reclamation coverage, and the published-driver cell. After adding proof, update the PR body; ClawSweeper should re-review automatically. If it does not, the PR author or someone with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review`. - [ ] **Resolve security concern: Verify stale authority cannot activate the Gateway** - The changed custody and recovery path crosses process lifetimes and asynchronous publication. Available current coverage does not show requester revocation or parent-generation replacement being rejected before native activation. - [ ] **Resolve merge risk (P1)** - The current settlement-publication-to-native-activation path lacks final-effect evidence that requester revocation or parent-generation replacement prevents restart, while an authorized recovery still succeeds. - [ ] **Complete next step (P2)** - Provide current production-path authority proof showing permitted recovery and rejection before native activation after requester revocation or parent-generation replacement; redact credentials, private paths, IP addresses, and non-public endpoints. ## Findings - [medium] Verify stale authority cannot activate the Gateway — `src/cli/update-cli/update-command-package.ts:386`
